notablePrerequisites: You have three or more land cards in hand.
description:
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding a land card.
Slogurk and Surly Badgersaur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Slogurk and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
